correctness.rationale: Using the exact Pierce alternating-product normalization and least onset N of consecutive digits, split the sequence into a rational prefix and tail T_m. Beta integration gives T_m=int_0^1 t^(m-1) exp(t-1)dt, T_1=1-e^-1 and integration-by-parts recurrence T_m=1-(m-1)T_(m-1). Induction on derangement recurrence gives T_m=(-1)^(m-1)D_(m-1)+(-1)^m(m-1)!e^-1. The coefficient of e^-1 after attaching any admissible prefix is rational nonzero, so Hermite transcendence implies every exceptional x is transcendental; Ahn Theta maps onto complement C, so all algebraic irrational x are in its image. Independent exact recurrence checks m=1..100 and 45-digit alternating series comparisons m=1..11 corroborate the proof.
residual_risks: Only eventually consecutive Pierce tails are addressed, with admissible prefix; no algebraic-independence result.
